components.title: Recap: Log Schema and Step Types
components.teaches: Students quickly review the log schema and control‑flow taxonomy from the previous session to reinforce shared vocabulary before advanced topics.

components.title: Advanced Tracing: Nested and Parallel Loops
components.teaches: Students examine how nested iterative loops and concurrent agent executions appear in a single log, learning to disambiguate interleaved control‑flow steps using correlation IDs.

components.title: Worked Example: Real‑World Agent Log Analysis
components.teaches: Students walk through a full‑scale log from a production coding agent, extracting the generate‑test‑refactor cycles, identifying bottlenecks, and proposing instrumentation improvements.

components.title: Activity: Group Log Trace Report
components.teaches: In teams, students receive an anonymized iterative development log, produce a structured trace report linking each control‑flow step to code artifacts, and present findings.
